divergences.summary: Keep the accepted virtual user document, explicit Save, readonly/disposal fences and sandboxed capability clients. verification.obligation: Verify every exact pinned source blob. Adapted file rationale and explicit exclusions own source-to-local differences; this check alone does not establish behavior.
